_comment: Skills that are installed from their upstream source instead of being bundled (licence or size). installer/install-claude-layer.py --upstream-skills clones each repo at the pinned commit. kind 'folder' copies one folder into skills/<name>; kind 'setup' clones into skills/<name> and runs the upstream setup with the listed arguments (it registers its own hooks and per-skill folders). 'hosts' (only with the Codex integration): a setup kind runs hosts.codex.setup from the same checkout, so gstack also serves Codex (~/.codex/skills/gstack and its gstack-* links); a folder kind is also placed in ~/.agents/skills/<hosts.agents.name>. The visibility of every skill (off, name-only, user-invocable-only) comes from skillOverrides in settings.template.json.

skills.name: gstack
skills.note: about 60 /gstack-* skills plus the AskUserQuestion hooks (question-log, auq-error-fallback, question-preference); Windows: run setup.ps1 by hand

skills.name: remotion
skills.licence: none declared upstream: installed from the source, not redistributed
skills.note: Remotion best practices (skill name remotion-best-practices, folder remotion)
